bio.text: Dan Gehlbach, a Republican, represents District 46 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Gehlbach as serving a second term.

The biography describes Gehlbach as a small business owner, former certified internal auditor and former high school teacher, and a former member of the Waukee Community School District's Board of Directors.

It lists a bachelor's degree from the University of Kansas and a master's degree from Arizona State University, and says Gehlbach was born in 1977 in Des Moines, was raised in Urbandale and lives there.
